name: Myth fact card
summary: Split card: MYTH struck through with a red cross on top, then FACT with a green tick revealed below.

params.name: myth
params.default: Goldfish only have a three second memory
params.note: the myth; up to three lines

params.name: fact
params.default: Goldfish can remember things for months
params.note: the fact; up to three lines

params.name: factAt
params.note: frames after the start when the fact appears

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at

example.myth: Goldfish only have a three second memory
example.fact: Goldfish can remember things for months
